Hymn 218: We Give Thee But Thine Own
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: E-flat Major
Composer: Hans Georg Nägeli

This is hymn number 218 titled "We Give Thee But Thine Own" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Hans Georg Nägeli and the lyrics were written by William W. How.
